g.text: J2: 3.3V expansion/probe header, not a 5V input.

g.desc: J2: 3.3V expansion/probe header, not a 5V input.

g.text: GP8 is dedicated to SRAM bank select.

g.desc: GP8 is dedicated to SRAM bank select.

g.text: R1-R40: discrete 10k 0603 pulls replacing the Rev B networks. R1-R16 A0-A15 to +5V; R17-R24 PICO_D0-D7 to GND; R25-R32 Z80 controls to +5V; R33-R36 3V3 startup pull-ups (breadboard R17-R20); R37-R40 startup pull-downs (breadboard R21-R24). Both data paths default disabled.

g.desc: R1-R40: discrete 10k 0603 pulls replacing the Rev B networks. R1-R16 A0-A15 to +5V; R17-R24 PICO_D0-D7 to GND; R25-R32 Z80 controls to +5V; R33-R36 3V3 startup pull-ups (breadboard R17-R20); R37-R40 startup pull-downs (breadboard R21-R24). Both data paths default disabled.

g.text: A2: socketed Stage 10 0.91in SSD1315 128x32 status OLED.

g.desc: A2: socketed Stage 10 0.91in SSD1315 128x32 status OLED.

g.text: Socket: 1x4 2.54 mm female header, 5.0 mm body (hand fit).

g.desc: Socket: 1x4 2.54 mm female header, 5.0 mm body (hand fit).

g.text: Header order GND, VCC, SCK, SDA bottom-to-top.

g.desc: Header order GND, VCC, SCK, SDA bottom-to-top.

g.text: SDA = J2.1 / GP22; SCK = J2.2 / GP26.

g.desc: SDA = J2.1 / GP22; SCK = J2.2 / GP26.

g.text: Module hovers over low-profile SMT parts only.

g.desc: Module hovers over low-profile SMT parts only.

g.text: VBUS -> +5V directly; no regulator, eFuse or OVP.

g.desc: VBUS -> +5V directly; no regulator, eFuse or OVP.

g.text: CC1 and CC2 each 5.1k to GND (R41, R42).

g.desc: CC1 and CC2 each 5.1k to GND (R41, R42).

g.text: Use a regulated 5V USB supply only.

g.desc: Use a regulated 5V USB supply only.

g.text: J3 is auxiliary: only ONE supply at a time.

g.desc: J3 is auxiliary: only ONE supply at a time.

g.text: Keep D1 to Pico VSYS; never join Pico VBUS.

g.desc: Keep D1 to Pico VSYS; never join Pico VBUS.

g.text: Z80 is the sole SRAM address/write master. Pico injects instructions with SRAM reads inhibited. RESET_N directly joins Pico and Z80 at 3.3V.

g.desc: Z80 is the sole SRAM address/write master. Pico injects instructions with SRAM reads inhibited. RESET_N directly joins Pico and Z80 at 3.3V.

g.text: BANK SELECT: Pico physical pin 11 / GP8 -> U4.17.

g.desc: BANK SELECT: Pico physical pin 11 / GP8 -> U4.17.

g.text: U4.3 -> U2.2 / A16 (5V side); LOW selects bank 0.

g.desc: U4.3 -> U2.2 / A16 (5V side); LOW selects bank 0.
